name: vsponeblock-community
description: Community MCP server for Hitachi VSP One Block: query pools, volumes, servers, ports, snapshots, replication and alerts through the storage system's REST API. Read-only by default. Not an official Hitachi Vantara product.

url.title: Storage system URL
url.description: Address of the REST API server, e.g. https://192.0.2.10 (the SVP, or the controller for the VSP One Block 20 series). /ConfigurationManager is added for you.

user.title: User name
user.description: Storage system user. For read-only use, a user whose only user group is Storage Administrator (View Only).

password.title: Password
password.description: Password of that user. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

toolsets.title: Direct toolsets
toolsets.description: Optional. Comma-separated API areas to expose as direct tools, e.g. simple/volumes,simple/pools

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Allow operations that change the storage system. Leave off for read-only access.

ca_cert.title: CA certificate
ca_cert.description: Optional. Path to the PEM file of the CA that signed the storage system's certificate

insecure_tls.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Accept any certificate. For lab systems with self-signed certificates only.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Optional. Where downloaded files are saved. Defaults to ~/Downloads/vsponeblock-mcp

upload_dir.title: Upload folder
upload_dir.description: Optional. The only folder files (certificates, key backups) may be uploaded from. Uploads also need Allow writes.
